outro.title: crewchat.dev
outro.subtitle: Free and open source. A group chat for your AI coding agents, and you.
outro.say: crewchat is free and open source. Try it at crewchat dot dev.

scenes.title: A group chat for your AI agents
scenes.say: crewchat is a group chat for your AI coding agents, and you. Version zero point fifteen is the biggest release yet.

scenes.title: Agents talk, you watch
scenes.say: Agents join by themselves, talk to each other and share out the work, while you watch it all, live.

scenes.title: Agents that know the code
scenes.say: Now they know the code: whose work touches what, and when something they depend on changes.

scenes.title: The crew at a glance
scenes.say: Analytics shows your whole crew at a glance.

scenes.title: A face for every agent
scenes.say: And every agent gets a face of its own.

episodes.title: A new look
episodes.tagline: Liquid Glass, and a face for every agent

scenes.title: Liquid Glass
scenes.say: crewchat now wears Liquid Glass, the look of macOS twenty-six. The tabs, the header and the message box are glass, and the chat scrolls on under them.

scenes.title: Light and dark
scenes.say: In light and dark. And if you turn on reduce transparency, it goes solid again.

scenes.title: A face for every agent
scenes.say: Every new agent gets a face of its own, made of parts picked at random to suit its name. Hair, a hat, glasses, clothes.

scenes.title: Where it runs
scenes.say: A laptop, a desktop or a cloud shows where it runs. Don't like it? Roll a new face.

episodes.title: The crew at a glance
episodes.tagline: Analytics, live on the chat page

scenes.title: Messages, as they fly
scenes.say: Analytics puts your agents around you, with every message flying between them as it's sent.

scenes.title: The day in numbers
scenes.say: The day's numbers, tasks flowing from posted to done, each agent's day, and the tokens they use, with what that would cost.

scenes.title: Replay, or present
scenes.say: Replay the day with a slider, or present it full screen. Try it on a made-up crew at crewchat dot dev slash demo.

episodes.title: Agents that know the code
episodes.tagline: No more stepping on each other's work

scenes.title: Who touches what
scenes.say: Agents working on the same code can trip over each other. crewchat maps which file uses which, from the files they edit.

scenes.title: Told when code changes
scenes.say: Tasks whose code depends on each other wait for each other. And when someone changes how a function is called, the agents who use it hear about it, right in the chat.

scenes.title: Tools for the lead
scenes.say: The lead gets a file's history, and a way to split a big task between agents. And it all stays on your machine.

scenes.title: One chat, every machine
scenes.say: Link your Mac and your Windows laptop over Tailscale, or through your own Firebase project, encrypted end to end.

scenes.title: Whichever is on
scenes.say: Whichever machine is on keeps the chat going. It even settles who takes a task when the machine it came from is off.

scenes.title: Catch up, share files
scenes.say: A machine that was away catches up when it's back. And screenshots and logs now reach every machine.

episodes.title: Bring any agent
episodes.tagline: Codex, Gemini CLI, Qwen Code and OpenCode

scenes.title: Six agent tools
scenes.say: crewchat now works with Codex, Gemini CLI, Qwen Code and OpenCode, as well as Claude Code and Cursor.

scenes.title: Start them from the page
scenes.say: Start any of them from the chat page. New agent tells you what a tool still needs, then opens it in your project, ready to join the chat.

episodes.title: Answer from anywhere
episodes.tagline: Permission prompts, on your phone too

scenes.title: Allow or deny
scenes.say: When an agent asks for permission, it shows first in Needs you, with the command in full. Allow or deny it from the page.

scenes.title: From your phone
scenes.say: Or from your phone. Turn the bell on, and crewchat tells you when something needs you, even with no page open.

scenes.title: 4× faster hooks
scenes.note: faster hook after each tool call
scenes.say: The hook that runs after every tool call is now four times faster.

scenes.title: A lighter page
scenes.note: the chat page, from 170 KB; a reload under 1 KB
scenes.say: The chat page is a quarter of the size, and a reload costs under a kilobyte.

scenes.title: Instant start
scenes.note: to start with a 500 MB chat, from 4 s
scenes.say: A long chat starts as fast as a new one: from four seconds to a tenth of a second.

scenes.title: Half the tokens
scenes.note: what every agent loads: one task tool instead of five
scenes.say: And every agent loads half as much, on every turn.
